name: caps-lock-state
description: This is a Visual Studio Code plugin that provides panels to display the Caps Lock key's status.

enumDescriptions: Change the editor cursor color when Caps Lock is ON.
Highlight the current line with a background color when Caps Lock is ON.
Show a text indicator in the status bar when Caps Lock is ON.
Show a text decoration before the cursor when Caps Lock is ON.
Show an icon in the editor gutter when Caps Lock is ON.
caps-lock-state.choose_display_method.markdownDescription: Select how Caps Lock state is visually indicated in the editor.

caps-lock-state.delay_time.description: Polling interval for detecting Caps Lock state changes. (Unit: milliseconds)

caps-lock-state.cursor_color.markdownDescription:
Cursor color when Caps Lock is ON. This modifies the `editorCursor.foreground` color in your theme.

Examples: `#00ff00`, `red`, `rgba(0, 255, 0, 1)`

*Only effective when Display Method is set to `method_cursor_color`.*

caps-lock-state.line_background_color.markdownDescription:
Color for the current line background highlight.

Examples: `#ff0000b3`, `rgba(255, 0, 0, 0.7)`, `red`

*Only effective when Display Method is set to `method_background_color`.*

caps-lock-state.status_bar_text.markdownDescription:
Text shown in the status bar when Caps Lock is ON. Supports emoji and Unicode characters.

Examples: `🔒 Caps Lock ON!`, `⚠ CAPS`, `[A]`

*Only effective when Display Method is set to `method_status_bar`.*

caps-lock-state.cursor_text.markdownDescription:
Text displayed before the cursor position. Supports emoji and Unicode characters.

Examples: `🔒`, `⬤`, `CAPS`

*Only effective when Display Method is set to `method_cursor_text`.*

caps-lock-state.cursor_text_color.markdownDescription:
Color of the text displayed before the cursor.

Examples: `#ff0000`, `red`, `rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)`

*Only effective when Display Method is set to `method_cursor_text`.*
